m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: The Ice Dwarves demand we open the Steam Vents? DEMAND it, do they? Well, of course they do! But how can we be sure they'll re-start the Pumps?
The Vents are the only leverage we have! If those ice-blooded fools think they can-
I just heard this same argument in the Ice Dwarf City! You have each other's lives in your hands. What good does it do to destroy each other?
If the Dwarves of Athanor die, Spider wins! Somebody needs to make the first move toward peace. Why not let it be you?
You are right. Grandmother Raven gave us our mission, to keep Athanor balanced and protect the Chain. Not from the Ice Dwarves, but from Shadow.
We've forgotten our true mission, to our shame. Open the Vents - release the steam!
The Heating Element's stuck out of position - we can't make steam!
What? Don't just stand there - send engineers to fix that Element! Get that steam flowing!
More sabotage? I smell a Bat, Wizard. Let's go along.
Don' just go bargin' in there - it's too dangerous!
You there! Wait!
The Fire Dwarves sent you, eh? Why, for the terms of our surrender? We are doomed!
The prisoners? We had no choice but to take them captive. They clearly came to attack us - their offer of help was only a ruse!
Fire Dwarves are slaves to their passions - they cannot be reasoned with! We fixed the Lava Tube but they haven't turned on the Steam Vents!
If our red cousins want their soldiers freed they must re-open the Steam Vents. They must. We are dying!
But so are they - the Pumps are still off! Please, Councilor - free the prisoners as a gesture of goodwill, and re-start the Pumps.
How can we possibly do that? The Fire Dwarves will simply leave the Steam Vents off and then we're doomed!
The prisoners are the only leverage we have! We've got to use them to make the Fire Dwarves re-open the Steam Vents!
Yes. Go tell them we will not free their soldiers until the Steam Vents are open.
I'll come with you, Wizard!
Go quickly!
Go tell the Fire Dwarves we won't free the hostages until the Vents are open!
